# Project guidance

- This is a simulation-only prototype; do not describe it as a safety device or substitute for caregiver supervision.
- Keep camera ingestion, biometric identification, persistent child data, and external alert delivery out of scope unless explicitly requested and reviewed.
- Prefer data minimization, local processing, explicit consent, short retention, and fail-safe behavior.
- Validate changes with the test suite and keep simulation-only warnings visible in API documentation.
